description: This file defines the CsvAutoDetect class used for detecting CSV file settings such as delimiter, enclosure, header presence, date, and time formats. It includes methods to parse CSV files and infer configuration parameters for import operations, primarily used within the SuiteCRM module for importing data.

classes.name: CsvAutoDetect
classes.description: Class to detect CSV file settings such as delimiter, enclosure, header presence, and date/time formats for import configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CsvAutoDetect object with the CSV filename and maximum parse depth.

methods.name: getCsvSettings
methods.description: Attempts to detect the CSV delimiter and enclosure characters by parsing the file.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Determines whether the CSV file has a header row based on field name matching.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Internally used to identify date or time formats in CSV data.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Detects the date format used in the CSV file.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Detects the time format used in the CSV file.
